Project Management & Implementation Unit

Strengthening Social Protection Delivery System in Sindh

Sindh Social Protection Authority

Social Protection Department

Government of Sindh

 

 

 

 

REQUEST FOR EXPRESSIONS OF INTEREST

 

Assignment Title: Selection of Individual Consultant for the position of Monitoring & Evaluation Specialist

Credit No.: IDA / 7229-PK

The Government of Sindh (herein after called Borrower) has received financing from the International Development Association (IDA) (the Bank) in the form of a credit (hereinafter called credit) towards the cost of strengthening social protection system in Sindh.

The Project Director, Project Management & Implementation Unit, Strengthening Social Protection Delivery System in Sindh and it is intended to apply part of the proceeds of this credit for payments to the following “Individual Consultant Services” to be procured under this project.

The consulting services to be procured on Contract basis are as follows:

Qualification

Experience

  • 16 years of education in Social Sciences, Economics, Public Health, Epidemiology & Biostatistics/ Statistics, Public/ Business Administration, or any other related disciplines from a reputed HEC-recognized university.

 

  • Advanced certificates in M&E, statistics or economics shall be accorded due weightage
  • At least eight (08) years of relevant experience in monitoring/evaluation of social protection/poverty alleviation programs/projects.

 

Demonstrated experience in:

  • Developing logical framework.
  • Sampling design.
  • Conducting assessments and surveys.
  • Data quality assessments and oversight.
  • Managing and providing training to partners.
  • Facilitating and serving as the project liaison for externally managed evaluations

Skills:

  • Excellent written and verbal communication, presentation, and stakeholder engagement skills.
  • Proven ability to work in a collaborative, multi-tier team environment

Interested applicants must send their Expression of Interest / Applications along with their detailed updated Curriculum Vitae highlighting qualifications and experience in carrying out similar assignments including references for possible checks, along with attested copies of CNIC, degrees/certificates, transcripts and experience certificates from previous organizations on the address below either by registered courier services or by email at hr@sspa.gos.pk with the subject line clearly mentioning the position applied for on or before August 12, 2026.

The attention of interested Consultants is drawn to Section III, paragraphs, 3.14, 3.16, and 3.17 of the World Bank’s “Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers” (November 2020) (“Procurement Regulations”), setting forth the World Bank’s policy on conflict of interest.

The Consultants will be selected in accordance with the Open Competitive Selection of Individual Consultants method set out in the Procurement Regulations of the World Bank for IPF Borrowers (November 2020) available on www.worldbank.org. Further information can be obtained at the address below during office hours i.e. 1000 to 1700 hours. REQUEST FOR EXPRESSIONS OF INTEREST

(INDIVIDUAL CONSULTANT)

 

 

Senior Waste Management Policy and Institutional Development Consultant                        

 

Country: Sint Maarten

Project: The Sint Maarten Emergency Debris Management Project

Assignment Title: Senior Consultant-Waste Mng Policy and Institutional Development

Credit/Loan no.: TF-B9747

Reference no.: SX-NRPB-560450-CS-INDV

 

The Government of Sint Maarten has received financing from the World Bank toward the cost of the Emergency Debris Management Project (EDMP) and intends to apply part of the proceeds for consulting services.

The overall objective of the assignment is to engage a Senior Consultant to provide specialized technical and strategic expertise to support the implementation of activities aimed at strengthening the waste management sector. The Consultant will contribute to policy enhancement, capacity building and asset management within the Ministry of Public Housing, Spatial Planning, Environment and Infrastructure (VROMI) and other relevant government entities.

 

The assignment will support ongoing operations and the establishment of a stronger institutional and policy framework for sustainable waste management and improved sector performance.

The Supervision Consultant will deliver the following:

  • Inception Report and Work Plan
  • Develop a National Disaster Waste Policy (Activity E.1)
  • Development of Terms of Reference for dedicated policy capacity (Activity A.3)
  • Public guidance protocols for hurricane-related waste management and disaster readiness (Activity E.2)
  • Final assignment report

 

The Consultant shall ensure that all activities are implemented in accordance with the quality standards, time and budget elaborated in the contract document.

 

The National Recovery Program Bureau (NRPB) now invites eligible consultants (“Consultants”) to indicate their interest in providing the Services. Interested Consultants should provide information demonstrating that they have the required qualifications and relevant experience to perform the Services.

The selection criteria are:

  • Advanced degree in Environmental Engineering, Waste Management, Environmental Policy, Public Administration, Civil Engineering, or related discipline.
  • At least 10 years of professional experience in disaster waste management, environmental governance, institutional strengthening, or related fields.
  • Demonstrated experience in coordination across multiple actors.
  • Demonstrated experience conducting standalone activities in a wide context, capacity-building initiatives, and policy advisory assignments.
  • Experience in supporting government agencies in the development of policies and operational improvement programs.
  • Strong stakeholder engagement, facilitation, analytical, and report-writing skills.

 

Applicants are free to choose a format for their Expression of Interest. At this stage, Consultants are expected to provide:

  1. CVs including relevant information about qualifications and expertise, strategic competencies or achievements;
  2. Relevant references from previous similar projects/clients.

 

NRPB reserves the right to invite any or all interested candidates to an interview.

 

The attention of interested Consultants is drawn to Section III, paragraphs, 3.14, 3.16, and 3.17 of the World Bank’s “Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers” November 2020 edition (“Procurement Regulations”), setting forth the World Bank’s policy on conflict of interest.

 

A Consultant will be selected in accordance with the Open Competitive Selection of Individual Consultants as set forth in the Procurement Regulations.

 

Expressions of interest must be submitted via the NRPB’s procurement portal which can be done via: National Recovery Program Bureau of St. Maarten - Senior Waste Management Policy and Institutional Development Consultant by Monday, September 7th, 2026 at 5:00 PM (AST).

 

All queries from interested bidders must be submitted electronically to https://nrpbsxm.bonfirehub.com through the Vendor Discussions section under the respective project. Interested bidders should register in the NRPB's procurement portal at https://nrpbsxm.bonfirehub.com/login/. Detailed instructions for registration are available at https://nrpbsxm.org/procurement.

Request Expression of Interest (REOI)

Consulting Services – Firm Selection

SYSTEM INTEGRATOR (SI) FOR MOMS LMIS ARCHITECTURE REVITALIZATION, DEVELOPMENT, ENHANCEMENT, AND PROVIDING IMPLEMENTATION SUPPORT SERVICES

Reference No. ID-MOM-555653-CS-QCBS 

Labour Market Information and Skills for Transformation for Labour Market Flexibility Project – International Bank for Reconstruction and Development – Loan Number 9636-ID

 

The Government of the Republic of Indonesia has received financing from the World Bank toward the cost of Labour Market Information and Skills for Transformation for Labour Market Flexibility (LISTRAF) and intend to apply part of the proceeds for consulting services. 

The main purpose of this assignment is to focus on the revitalization of the existing SIAPkerja platform, a digital ecosystem developed and managed by the Ministry of Manpower (hereinafter referred to as the “Ministry”), through the following: (i) redesign of the SIAPkerja user interface based on user mapping and end-user needs; (ii) redesign of the system architecture to improve interoperability among existing Ministry services and across other ministry/agency services; (iii) strengthening of system features to address unmet service needs; and (iv) enhancement of IT architecture and supporting technology infrastructure.

The duration of the assignment is expected to be around 12 (twelve) months. The total estimated level of effort is about 198 (one hundred ninety eight)  professional staff months. The complete scope of services and other details pertaining to this assignment including the key and non-key experts required are provided in the Terms of Reference which can be found at https://spseicb.lkpp.go.id. 

The Ministry of Manpower now invites eligible consultant firms (“Consultants”) to indicate their interest in providing the services. They shall submit the Expression of Interest (EOI) demonstrating that they have the required qualifications and relevant experience to perform the services, i.e presenting the consultant/firm profile, the legality of consultant/firm, description of similar assignment on the last 10 (ten) years (the information shall be completed with the assignment title, assignment location, name of employer, type of services provided, period of work (start and completion dates), and contract value, as evidenced by the Contract Agreement and the Handover Certificate). The experience data should be in .pdf format submit on https://spseicb.lkpp.go.id and should be in .xls format submit on pokmilalistraf@gmail.com, the submission of EOI must be submitted before as per the schedule stated in the SPSE ICB LKPP. 

The shortlisting criteria are as follows: 

  1. Demonstrated experience in designing and managing Integrated Digital Enterprise Architecture/ Core Systems (e.g., Digital Government MIS/National Financial Management Systems/Labor Market Information System (LMIS), Enterprise Resource Planning Systems (ERP) /Public Employment Service (PES Platform/Large scale Government Enterprise MIS or relevant projects of similar scale and nature) for the last 10 years;
  2. At least 3 Enterprise Architecture development projects/System Development projects - out of which at least any 2 projects mentioned above must have been completed within the past 10 years (remaining 1 project could also be an ongoing project);
  3. Proven experience in managing projects with system accountability for public services, meaning the firm has been responsible for the performance, reliability, security, and continuity of systems serving the public.

Note: Firms meeting all three criteria will be shortlisted and invited to submit a full technical and financial proposal.

 

Consultant may associate with other firms in the form of a joint venture or sub-consultancy to enhance their qualification. For the purpose of shortlisting, the qualifications of sub-consultants will not be considered in the EOI evaluation.  In the case of a joint venture, all the partners in the joint venture shall be jointly and severally liable for the entire contract, if selected.

The Consultant is drawn to paragraph 3.14, 3.16 and 3.17 of the World Bank of the Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers (September 2023) (Procurement Regulations), setting forth the World Bank’s policy on conflict of interest.

A Consultant will be selected in accordance with the Quality and Cost Based Selection (QCBS) method set out in the Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers (September 2023). Further information may obtained in the below address during office hours 7.30 to 16.00 (GMT+7).

Services de Consultants

 

NOM DU PAYS : TCHAD

 

NOM DU PROJET : PROJET D’AMELIORATION DES RESULTATS D’APPRENTISSAGE DE L’EDUCATION DE BASE (PARAEB) - P 175803

N° de Don IDA : E-180

 

Désignation de la Mission : Contrôle de qualité et suivi des Travaux de Construction des infrastructures scolaires dans les Provinces du : Moyen-chari, Mandoul, Salamat, Sila, Ouaddaï, Batha, Hadjer-Lamis et du Lac.

 

1. Le Gouvernement de la République du Tchad (ci-après dénommé le « Bénéficiaire ») a reçu un Don provenant de l’Association Internationale de Développement (AID) en vue de financer le coût du PARAEB et a l’intention d’utiliser une partie du montant de ce Don pour effectuer les paiements autorisés au titre au titre des contrats pour lequel cet avis est émis. Le PARAEB, se propose

2. Le PARAEB invite les firmes de consultants (« Consultants ») admissibles à manifester leur intérêt à fournir les services décrits ci-après : Recrutement des Cabinets/Bureaux de Contrôle de la qualité et du suivi des Travaux de Construction des infrastructures scolaires dans les Provinces du Moyen Chari, Mandoul, Salamat, Sila, Ouaddaï, Batha, Hadjar Lamis, et du Lac. 

3. Les Consultants (firmes) intéressés doivent produire les informations sur leurs capacités et expériences démontrant qu’ils sont qualifiés pour les prestations (documentations, références de prestations similaires, expériences dans des missions comparables, disponibilité de personnel qualifié, curriculum vitae etc…). L’intérêt manifesté par une entreprise ou un bureau d’études n’implique aucune obligation de la part du Projet de le retenir sur la liste restreinte.

Les Consultants peuvent s’associer avec d’autres firmes pour renforcer leurs compétences respectives en la forme d’un groupement solidaire ou d’un accord de sous-traitant.

 

4. Les critères d’éligibilité du Consultant sur la liste restreinte et la procédure de sélection seront conformes aux principes décrits dans le Règlement de Passation de Marchés pour les Emprunteurs de FPI » du 1er juillet 2016, 6ème édition, février 2025. La méthode utilisée sera la Sélection Fondée sur les Qualifications du Consultant (SQC).

5. Les Consultants intéressés peuvent obtenir des informations supplémentaires à l'adresse mentionnée ci-dessous aux heures d’ouverture de bureaux : Du lundi au jeudi de 8 h 00 à 15 h 00 et le vendredi de 08 heures à 11 h 00,  ou par e-mail adressé à : yves.djassinan@gmail.com abdelazizjunior215@gmail.com /hamitmahamat87@gmail.com

Pour plus amples renseignements sur les services en question, veuillez consulter les Termes de référence attachés à cet avis.

RECRUTEMENT DU CABINET CHARGÉ DE L’AUDIT FINANCIER ET COMPTABLE DU PROJET ENCORE POUR L’EXERCICE 2022 COMPRENANT AUSSI LE PPA

  1. Le Gouvernement de la République Démocratique du Congo a reçu de la Banque Mondiale un financement de l’ordre de 250 millions de dollars américains en vue de financer les activités du Projet d’Amélioration du Recouvrement des recettes et de la Gestion des Dépenses en RDC (Projet ENCORE) dont la coordination et la gestion sont placées sous la responsabilité du Comité de Pilotage et d’Orientation de la réforme des Finances publiques (COREF).
  2. Les services, au titre de ce contrat, portent sur les prestations du Consultant visant à exprimer une opinion professionnelle sur la gestion de fonds du Projet d’Amélioration du Recouvrement des Recettes et de la Gestion des Dépenses à la fin de chaque exercice comptable et s’assurer que les ressources mises à la disposition ont été utilisées aux fins pour lesquelles elles ont été octroyées en vue de l’atteinte de l’objectif assigné.
  3. Le COREF invite les candidats admissibles (firmes) à manifester leur intérêt à fournir les services décrits ci-dessus. Le Consultant doit être un Cabinet d’Audit et d’Expertise Comptable réputé, indépendant et faisant profession habituelle de réviser les comptes, d’un ordre professionnel comptable reconnu par l’IFAC, la FIDEF, et ayant une expérience confirmée en audit financiers des comptes des projets de développement, notamment les projets financés par la Banque Mondiale. Il doit mobiliser au moins le personnel clé ci-après dont le profil est spécifié dans les termes de référence. Il s’agit de :

 

  • Un expert-comptable
  • un chef de mission
  •  
  • 4. Il est porté à l’attention des Consultants que les dispositions des paragraphes 3.14, 3.16 et 3.17 du « Règlement de Passation des Marchés pour les Emprunteurs sollicitant le Financement de Projets d’Investissement (FPI) », édition de novembre 2020 relatives aux règles de la Banque mondiale en matière de conflit d’intérêts sont applicables ;
  •  
  • 5 Les cabinets ayant exécuté des contrats similaires, obtenus par compétitions, dans lesquels les prix sont un atout, doivent lister les références sur les activités et indiquer la méthode de sélection, le montant du contrat et le maître d’ouvrage.

 

6 Un Candidat sera sélectionné selon la méthode de sélection basée sur les Qualifications du Consultant (QC) telle que décrite dans le Règlement susmentionné ;

 7. Les consultants intéressés peuvent obtenir les termes de référence et informations supplémentaires à l’adresse ci-dessous et aux heures suivantes : de 09 heures à 15 heures, heure de Kinshasa ;

8.
